text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Bahraini press on Thursday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Oman approves plans for $70 million sugar refinery with a capacity of 360,000 tonnes a year.
- Egypt approves nearly 1,500 investment projects from January to November worth more than $7 billion.
- International Investment Group signs deal to become an agent in Kuwait for the Jeddah-based Islamic Development Bank.
- Foreign minister expresses hope that differences between Bahrain and Qatar would be settled. Bahrain and Qatar are locked in a dispute over small Gulf islands.
- State Security Court adjourns until December 25 case against two Qataris accused of spying for Qatar.
- Bahrain Telecommunications Company opens a new commercial complex in Manama at a cost of seven million dinars.
